title: ...treat a household thermal or heat burn
desc: Reduce tissue damage and prevent severe infection immediately after a burn.
todos: Cool the burn immediately under cool (not cold or ice) running water for 10â€“20 minutes.
Remove rings or tight items from affected area before swelling begins.
Cover burn loosely with clean, non-stick sterile gauze or plastic film wrap.
Do NOT pop blisters, apply butter, ice, or ointment to open skin.
Seek urgent medical care if burn is larger than 3 inches or on face, hands, or major joints.
